class.name: MarkdownCalloutStyle
class.brief_description: Visual styling resource for a single callout kind in a [MarkdownTheme].
class.description: Defines the default title, accent color, title color, optional icon texture, and optional background [StyleBox] used to render a GitHub/Obsidian-style callout block (such as [code]> [!NOTE][/code], [code]> [!TIP][/code], [code]> [!IMPORTANT][/code], [code]> [!WARNING][/code], [code]> [!CAUTION][/code], or a custom kind). Instances are stored in [member MarkdownTheme.callouts] keyed by uppercase kind name (for example [code]"NOTE"[/code] or [code]"LORE"[/code]). Modifying any property emits [signal Resource.changed], which automatically triggers a layout and redraw on any [MarkdownView] using the owning [MarkdownTheme].

method.name: create
method.description: Creates and returns a new [MarkdownCalloutStyle] configured with the given [param title], [param accent_color], and optional [param title_color], [param icon], and [param panel_style].

method.name: resolve_title_color
method.description: Returns [member title_color] if its alpha channel is greater than [code]0.0[/code]; otherwise returns [member accent_color].

members.member: Primary accent color used for the callout's left accent bar, default translucent panel tint and border (when [member panel_style] is [code]null[/code]), and fallback title/icon color when [member title_color] is transparent.

Optional custom icon drawn to the left of the callout header title. When [code]null[/code], a crisp procedural vector icon is drawn for the five built-in callout kinds ([code]NOTE[/code], [code]TIP[/code], [code]IMPORTANT[/code], [code]WARNING[/code], [code]CAUTION[/code]) and a diamond badge is drawn for custom kinds.
Optional [StyleBox] drawn as the callout container background. When [code]null[/code], a procedural rounded panel tinted from [member accent_color] is drawn instead.
Default header title displayed when the Markdown callout directive does not specify a custom title (for example [code]> [!NOTE][/code]). If empty, the callout kind name is capitalized as a fallback.
Explicit color for the callout header title and procedural icon. When its alpha channel is [code]0.0[/code] (the default), [method resolve_title_color] falls back to [member accent_color].
